yaml:
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w6-chatty
spec:
  native: true
  params:
    inputs:
      - name: lines
        type: string
        default: "2000"
      - name: pad_bytes
        type: string
        default: "1024"
      - name: interval_s
        type: string
        default: "0"
      - name: hbfile
        type: string
        default: "/data/w62b-hb.log"
  agentSelector:
    - kind:linux
  steps:
    - name: chatty
      run: |
        pad=$(awk 'BEGIN{s="";for(i=0;i<{{ .Params.pad_bytes }};i++)s=s "x";print s}')
        echo "chatty-begin lines={{ .Params.lines }} pad_bytes={{ .Params.pad_bytes }} interval_s={{ .Params.interval_s }} $(date -u +%FT%T.%NZ)"
        echo "== begin $(date -u +%FT%T.%NZ)" >> {{ .Params.hbfile }}
        i=1
        while [ "$i" -le {{ .Params.lines }} ]; do
          ts=$(date -u +%FT%T.%NZ)
          echo "chatty $i $ts $pad"
          echo "$i $ts" >> {{ .Params.hbfile }}
          i=$((i + 1))
          sleep {{ .Params.interval_s }}
        done
        echo "== end $(date -u +%FT%T.%NZ)" >> {{ .Params.hbfile }}
        echo "chatty-end $(date -u +%FT%T.%NZ)"
